purpose: Close the player-visible cliff lane: multi-tier generation, useful traversal density, authored ramp alignment, dry inland ladders, and correct actor/cliff depth ordering without replacing semantic terrain or certified LPC cliff art.

structuralGrammar.highlandCoreRule: Broad geographic highland cores inside an already-cleaned raised footprint materialize at Level 4 only when an inset Level-2 shoulder is preserved; Level 3 appears only inside a certified 4->3->2 ramp corridor.
structuralGrammar.coastalRelief: Level 1 remains reserved for authored coastal relief where permitted by the coastal grammar.

traversal.rampDensity: one certified south gateway per eligible exact-level component plus up to three additional spatially-separated gateways as usable south perimeter grows
traversal.ladderHost: exact straight south true-cliff face only
traversal.ladderDensity: one to three per eligible exact-level component based on valid straight-face count

renderDepth.depthKey: top edge of authored foot row
renderDepth.expectedBehavior: actors whose foot anchors remain in projected cliff-body rows are occluded; actors that cross onto/beyond the authored foot row render in front
